title: Normalized membrane ratio of TROP2 as a predictor of clinical outcomes with datopotamab deruxtecan in non-small-cell lung cancer
zh_title: TROP2归一化膜比率可预测Dato-DXd在NSCLC的疗效
summary: 研究开发并验证计算病理生物标志物TROP2归一化膜比率，量化亚细胞定位并预测非鳞NSCLC患者的无进展与总生存获益。
key_points: 提出全监督计算病理方法TROP2定量连续评分
常规免疫组化视觉评分无法预测TROP2靶向ADC疗效
该指标与Dato-DXd治疗后的PFS和OS改善相关
reason: 同行评审，开发并验证的计算病理预后标志物，具临床结局关联，属重要档
abstract: This work developed and validated a computational pathology biomarker—the TROP2 normalized membrane ratio—that quantifies subcellular TROP2 localization and predicts improved progression-free and overall survival with datopotamab deruxtecan in patients with nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer lacking actionable genomic alterations. Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd)—a trophoblast cell surface antigen 2 (TROP2)-directed antibody–drug conjugate—has demonstrated efficacy in patients with advanced nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ± actionable genomic alterations. However, TROP2 expression by pathologist assessment using conventional immunohistochemistry with visual scoring does not predict response to TROP2-directed antibody–drug conjugates in NSCLC. We developed TROP2 quantitative continuous scoring (QCS)—a fully supervised computational pathology approach that quantifies TROP2 expression in individual NSCLC cells and subcellular components from immunohistochemistry-stained slides. Using QCS to determine TROP2 expression at the tumor cell membrane and cytoplasm, normalized membrane ratio (NMR) was developed (ratio of membrane relative to membrane + cytoplasmic TROP2) in the biomarker-evaluable population of patients with advanced NSCLC in the TROPION-PanTumor01 study ( n = 115). The TROP2 NMR cut-point was optimized and validated in patients with nonsquamous NSCLC without actionable genomic alterations (primary intended-use population, n = 221) in the biomarker-evaluable population ( n = 352) of the TROPION-Lung01 trial. Association with clinical outcomes was assessed. Progression-free survival was longer in Dato-DXd-treated (median 7.2 versus 4.0 months; hazard ratio 0.40, 95% confidence interval 0.25–0.64) but not docetaxel-treated (median 4.1 versus 4.4 months; hazard ratio 0.94, 95% confidence interval 0.59–1.49) patients with TROP2 NMR-positive versus TROP2 NMR-negative samples (treatment by biomarker status interaction P = 0.0098), indicating that TROP2 NMR may be a predictive biomarker for Dato-DXd.
zh_abstract: 本研究开发并验证了一种计算病理学生物标志物——TROP2 归一化膜比值（TROP2 normalized membrane ratio），其可量化 TROP2 的亚细胞定位，并预测在缺乏可靶向基因组改变的非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer）患者中，datopotamab deruxtecan 治疗可改善无进展生存期和总生存期。Datopotamab deruxtecan（Dato-DXd）是一种靶向滋养层细胞表面抗原 2（TROP2）的抗体偶联药物，已在晚期非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）±可靶向基因组改变患者中显示出疗效。然而，病理学家使用传统免疫组化并以视觉评分评估 TROP2 表达，并不能预测 NSCLC 中对靶向 TROP2 的抗体偶联药物的应答。我们开发了 TROP2 定量连续评分（quantitative continuous scoring, QCS）——一种全监督计算病理学方法，可从免疫组化染色切片中量化单个 NSCLC 细胞及亚细胞组分中的 TROP2 表达。使用 QCS 确定肿瘤细胞膜和细胞质中的 TROP2 表达，并在 TROPION-PanTumor01 研究（n = 115）的生物标志物可评估晚期 NSCLC 患者人群中开发了归一化膜比值（normalized membrane ratio, NMR）（膜 TROP2 相对于膜 + 细胞质 TROP2 的比值）。TROP2 NMR 截断值在 TROPION-Lung01 试验生物标志物可评估人群（n = 352）中无可用靶向基因组改变的非鳞状 NSCLC 患者（主要预期使用人群，n = 221）中进行了优化和验证。评估了其与临床结局的关联。在 TROP2 NMR 阳性 versus 阴性的样本中，Dato-DXd 治疗患者的无进展生存期更长（中位 7.2 个月 versus 4.0 个月；风险比 0.40，95% 置信区间 0.25–0.64），而多西他赛治疗患者则无此差异（中位 4.1 个月 versus 4.4 个月；风险比 0.94，95% 置信区间 0.59–1.49）（治疗与生物标志物状态的交互作用 P = 0.0098），表明 TROP2 NMR 可能作为 Dato-DXd 的预测性生物标志物。

abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Purpose To develop and evaluate a rapid brain-age estimation framework using freely available Python tools and assess the clinical relevance of brain-age gap (BAG). Materials and Methods In this retrospective study conducted from March 2025 to August 2026, T1-weighted MR images from cohorts of cognitively normal adults (n = 4,346) were divided into training, validation, and internal test sets; two cohorts (n = 315 and 209) served as external test sets. Clinical evaluation used the BICWALZS cohort (n = 954; cognitively normal and various dementias). Preprocessing used freely available Python tools only. The model was trained to predict chronological age as the reference standard. Associations of the residualized BAG with diagnosis, amyloid PET positivity, white matter hyperintensity (WMH) severity, stroke history, and longitudinal clinical worsening were evaluated using ANCOVA, logistic regression, and Cox models. Results The development cohort included 4,346 cognitively normal adults (mean age, 47.0 ± 21.2 years; 2,414 women). Chronological age prediction yielded R2 = 0.95 and MAE, 3.76 years in the internal test set and R2 = 0.69-0.90 and MAE, 4.82-5.15 years in external test sets. The residualized BAG increased across diagnostic groups (P < .001) and was associated with WMH severity (odds ratio [OR], 1.64; P < .001) and stroke history (OR, 1.46; P < .001), but not with amyloid positivity after full adjustment (P = .17), and predicted longitudinal clinical worsening (HR, 1.92). Conclusion The framework accurately predicted age, while residualized BAG was associated with diagnosis, cerebrovascular burden, and longitudinal clinical worsening. © RSNA, 2026.

title: Automated Deep Learning Pipeline for Characterizing Left Ventricular Diastolic Function.
zh_title: 左室舒张功能评估的自动化深度学习流程
summary: 在两个中心回顾性分析舒张功能判读差异，并构建8个深度学习模型，在三个中心留出集外部测试。

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction (LVDD) is most commonly evaluated by echocardiography. However, without a sole identifying metric, LVDD is assessed by a diagnostic algorithm relying on secondary characteristics that is laborious and has the potential for interobserver variability. To characterize concordance in clinical evaluations of LVDD, we evaluated historical echocardiogram studies at 2 academic medical centers for variability between clinical diastology reported by clinicians and the 2016 and 2025 American Society of Echocardiography (ASE) guidelines. We developed a workflow of 8 deep learning (DL) models trained on over 155,000 studies to automate LVDD assessment. Model performance was evaluated on held-out test sets from 3 academic centers. In 592 studies from Cedars-Sinai Medical Center (CSMC), DL demonstrated 80.4% agreement and a weighted Cohen kappa of 0.62 with the 2016 ASE guideline assessment. In contrast, the CSMC clinician evaluation had 52.2% agreement and a kappa of 0.46 with the 2016 guidelines. In the Stanford Healthcare (SHC) cohort of 1572 studies, DL had 66.7% agreement and a kappa of 0.33 with the 2016 guidelines vs clinical diastology, with 32.7% agreement and a kappa of 0.14. Our DL workflow showed strong concordance with the 2025 guidelines, with agreements of 81.8% in CSMC and 68.1% in SHC. In a third validation cohort of 204 studies from the University of Chicago, DL had 34.3% agreement with the 2025 guidelines. Evaluating LVDD has high heterogeneity. We developed DL measurement-driven diastolic dysfunction, a pipeline of models that automates the clinical workflow of grading LVDD and can contribute to improved diagnosis of heart failure.
zh_abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] 左心室舒张功能障碍（LVDD）最常通过超声心动图评估。然而，由于没有单一的识别指标，LVDD 通过依赖次要特征的诊断算法进行评估，该过程费力且可能存在观察者间变异。为表征 LVDD 临床评估的一致性，我们评估了 2 个学术医学中心的历史超声心动图研究，以考察临床医生报告的临床舒张功能评估与 2016 年和 2025 年美国超声心动图学会（ASE）指南之间的变异性。我们开发了一个由 8 个深度学习（DL）模型组成的工作流程，这些模型在超过 155,000 项研究上训练，以自动化 LVDD 评估。模型性能在来自 3 个学术中心的留出测试集上评估。在来自 Cedars-Sinai 医学中心（CSMC）的 592 项研究中，DL 与 2016 ASE 指南评估显示出 80.4% 的一致性和 0.62 的加权 Cohen kappa。相比之下，CSMC 临床医生评估与 2016 指南的一致性为 52.2%，kappa 为 0.46。在 Stanford Healthcare（SHC）的 1572 项研究队列中，DL 与 2016 指南的一致性为 66.7%，kappa 为 0.33，而临床舒张功能评估的一致性为 32.7%，kappa 为 0.14。我们的 DL 工作流程与 2025 指南显示出高度一致性，在 CSMC 的一致性为 81.8%，在 SHC 为 68.1%。在来自 University of Chicago 的第三个验证队列 204 项研究中，DL 与 2025 指南的一致性为 34.3%。LVDD 评估具有高度异质性。我们开发了 DL 测量驱动的舒张功能障碍，这是一个模型流程，可自动化 LVDD 分级的临床工作流程，并有助于改善心力衰竭的诊断。

abstract: [Cornea] CorneAI was developed to classify anterior segment conditions into 9 categories. We aimed to develop a deep learning (DL) model for image-based classification among 4 selected keratitis categories: catarrhal ulcer, herpes stromal keratitis, peripheral ulcerative keratitis (PUK), and phlyctenular keratitis. We retrospectively collected 973 anterior segment images from 576 patients at 7 institutions in Japan and the Japan Ocular Imaging Registry. A YOLOv5 model was developed and evaluated using five-fold cross-validation. In an exploratory analysis, 17 ophthalmologists classified 192 images from 1 randomly selected validation fold. The positive predictive values (95% confidence interval) were 0.72 (0.59-0.83) for catarrhal ulcer, 0.84 (0.77-0.89) for herpes stromal keratitis, 0.88 (0.85-0.91) for PUK, and 0.72 (0.65-0.77) for phlyctenular keratitis. The areas under the receiver operating characteristic curves were 0.81 (0.74-0.87), 0.90 (0.87-0.93), 0.94 (0.93-0.96), and 0.91 (0.88-0.93), respectively. Sensitivity and specificity were 0.47 (0.37-0.58) and 0.98 (0.97-0.99) for catarrhal ulcer, 0.72 (0.65-0.79) and 0.97 (0.95-0.98) for herpes stromal keratitis, 0.93 (0.91-0.95) and 0.87 (0.84-0.90) for PUK, and 0.81 (0.75-0.86) and 0.91 (0.89-0.93) for phlyctenular keratitis. In an exploratory analysis, the diagnostic accuracies were 76.6% (95% CI, 70.1%-82.0%) for YOLOv5, 72.5 ± 9.3% (range, 53.6%-80.2%; n = 7) for corneal specialists, and 64.5 ± 10.2% (range, 45.3%-78.1%; n = 10) for ophthalmology residents. We developed a DL model for image-based classification among 4 selected keratitis categories. Further validation in broader clinical populations, including other corneal diseases and normal corneas, is required before clinical application.

abstract: Benchmark scores for medical large language models (LLMs) are difficult to interpret when scoring criteria cannot be traced to clinical evidence. Here we developed Med Evidence Bench (MEB; https://www.medevidencebench.org.cn/), comprising 1,536 physician-constructed items across three levels: guideline knowledge, standardized clinical scenarios and real-world laboratory scenarios. Each criterion stating a medical claim is linked to a versioned source-text span. Across ten LLMs, the Evidence Trace Score (ETS) was 0.975-0.997 for guideline knowledge, 0.292-0.658 for standardized scenarios and 0.182-0.447 for real-world scenarios, and rankings varied across levels. For real-world scenarios, scores for identifying clinical information (mean, 0.770) exceeded those for matching evidence (0.165) or formulating recommendations (0.160). On 1,296 criterion-level judgments, automated grading agreed with the majority vote of three physicians (macro-F1, 0.930; 95% confidence interval, 0.915-0.945), although agreement was lower for evidence application. These findings from Chinese-language materials indicate that guideline recall does not ensure patient-specific evidence use and do not establish clinical effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 当评分标准无法追溯至临床证据时，医学大语言模型（LLMs）的基准分数难以解释。在此我们开发了Med Evidence Bench（MEB；https://www.medevidencebench.org.cn/），包含1,536个由医生构建的条目，覆盖三个层级：指南知识、标准化临床场景和真实世界实验室场景。每条陈述医学主张的标准均链接到带版本控制的源文本片段。在十个LLM中，证据追溯分数（Evidence Trace Score，ETS）在指南知识为0.975-0.997，在标准化场景为0.292-0.658，在真实世界场景为0.182-0.447，且排名在不同层级间存在变化。对于真实世界场景，识别临床信息的分数（均值，0.770）高于匹配证据（0.165）或形成建议（0.160）的分数。在1,296项标准级判断上，自动评分与三名医生的多数投票一致（macro-F1，0.930；95%置信区间，0.915-0.945），尽管在证据应用方面一致性较低。这些来自中文材料的发现表明，指南回忆并不能确保患者特异性的证据使用，也不能确立临床有效性。

abstract: [Breathe (Sheffield, England)] Lung function evaluation is rapidly evolving beyond laboratory testing. While conventional tests remain the clinical reference standard, digital health technologies now enable respiratory assessment at home and in real-world settings through home-based systems, portable devices, and wearables. These tools can support repeated or continuous monitoring of traditional and digital biomarkers of respiratory health and disease. However, they differ in physiological detail, usability, degree of patient involvement and clinical maturity. In parallel, artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an important complement to these technologies. Machine learning and deep learning can support signal processing, quality control and interpretation of pulmonary function tests, while also extracting clinically relevant information from multimodal respiratory data collected outside controlled environments. Generative AI has a more emerging role, mainly in patient communication and educational support. For pulmonary function test interpretation, current evidence supports clinician-AI collaboration as the most realistic near-term model, rather than fully autonomous decision-making. This review summarises the main technologies currently available for lung function evaluation in adults and discusses the current and future role of AI in respiratory monitoring, interpretation and personalised care.
zh_abstract: [Breathe（Sheffield，England）] 肺功能评估正在迅速超越实验室检测。尽管传统检测仍是临床参考标准，数字健康技术如今通过居家系统、便携式设备和可穿戴设备，使呼吸评估能够在家庭和真实世界环境中进行。这些工具可支持对呼吸健康和疾病的传统及数字生物标志物进行重复或连续监测。然而，它们在生理细节、可用性、患者参与程度和临床成熟度方面存在差异。与此同时，人工智能（AI）正成为这些技术的重要补充。机器学习和深度学习可支持肺功能检测的信号处理、质量控制和解读，同时还能从受控环境之外收集的多模态呼吸数据中提取临床相关信息。生成式AI的作用则更为新兴，主要用于患者沟通和教育支持。对于肺功能检测解读，当前证据支持临床医生与AI协作是最现实的近期模式，而非完全自主决策。本综述总结了目前可用于成人肺功能评估的主要技术，并讨论了AI在呼吸监测、解读和个性化照护中的当前及未来作用。

title: From clinical negligence to digital healthcare harm: A medico-legal framework for liability assessment in the era of artificial intelligence, telemedicine and cybersecurity.
source: PubMed · Medicine, science, and the law

abstract: [Medicine, science, and the law] Healthcare is increasingly mediated by artificial intelligence, telemedicine platforms, electronic health records, cloud-based infrastructures and cybersecurity architectures. These technologies create new opportunities for care delivery, but also new pathways through which patients may be harmed. This article proposes Digital Healthcare Harm as an analytical category for the medico-legal assessment of adverse events arising wholly or partially from interactions between healthcare professionals, healthcare organisations, digital technologies and digital infrastructures. It further introduces a Socio-Technical Liability Framework structured around four layers: the clinical actor, the healthcare organisation, the digital technology and the digital infrastructure. The framework is intended to support the forensic and medico-legal reconstruction of causation, foreseeability, control, preventability and responsibility allocation in digitally mediated healthcare. It does not replace existing doctrines of professional negligence, organisational liability or product liability, but provides a structured method for analysing how these doctrines may interact in complex digital healthcare ecosystems. By integrating artificial intelligence, telemedicine and cybersecurity within a single medico-legal model, the article aims to assist legal medicine practitioners, forensic experts and healthcare institutions in assessing liability where patient harm cannot be adequately explained by clinician conduct alone.
zh_abstract: [医学、科学与法律] 医疗保健正日益由人工智能、远程医疗平台、电子健康记录、云基础设施和网络安全架构所介导。这些技术为护理服务创造了新机会，但也创造了患者可能受到伤害的新路径。本文提出数字医疗伤害（Digital Healthcare Harm）作为一个分析类别，用于对完全或部分源于医疗专业人员、医疗组织、数字技术和数字基础设施之间相互作用的不良事件进行医疗法律评估。本文进一步引入一个社会技术责任框架（Socio-Technical Liability Framework），其结构围绕四个层面：临床行为者、医疗组织、数字技术和数字基础设施。该框架旨在支持在数字介导的医疗保健中对因果关系、可预见性、控制、可预防性和责任分配进行法证和医疗法律重建。它不取代职业过失、组织责任或产品责任的现有原则，而是提供一种结构化方法，用于分析这些原则在复杂数字医疗生态系统中可能如何相互作用。通过将人工智能、远程医疗和网络安全整合到一个医疗法律模型中，本文旨在帮助法医从业者、法证专家和医疗机构在患者伤害不能仅由临床医生行为充分解释时评估责任。

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly positioned to improve heart failure (HF) care by predicting risk, enabling earlier disease identification, and supporting more reliable delivery of evidence-based management. Current applications span opportunistic detection for low ejection fraction, HF with preserved ejection fraction, and structural heart disease using tools such as AI-enabled electrocardiography, imaging- and electronic health record‒based risk stratification, clinician-facing decision support, remote medication titration, and wearable monitoring platforms. The strongest evidence suggests that AI is most effective when embedded into active clinical workflows that guide targeted testing, treatment optimization, and longitudinal follow-up, rather than functioning as passive alerts alone. This review examines the emerging landscape of AI-enabled HF care delivery from early detection through chronic management, with emphasis on implementation, workflow integration, and the capacity of these tools to improve diagnostic yield and ultimately scalability.
zh_abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] 人工智能（AI）日益被定位为通过预测风险、实现更早期疾病识别以及支持更可靠地实施循证管理来改善心力衰竭（HF）照护。当前应用涵盖利用AI赋能心电图、基于影像和电子健康记录的风险分层、面向临床医生的决策支持、远程药物滴定和可穿戴监测平台等工具，对低射血分数、射血分数保留型HF和结构性心脏病进行机会性检测。最强证据表明，当AI嵌入主动的临床工作流程以指导针对性检测、治疗优化和纵向随访，而非仅作为被动警报发挥作用时，其效果最佳。本综述考察AI赋能HF照护从早期检测到慢性管理的新兴格局，重点讨论实施、工作流程整合以及这些工具提高诊断产出并最终实现可扩展性的能力。

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] The management of cardiomyopathies relies on timely diagnosis, precise phenotyping, multimodal risk stratification, and longitudinal monitoring. These tasks require integration of high-dimensional signals from patient history, electrocardiography, imaging, biomarkers, and longitudinal health records, data streams well-suited to artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled pattern recognition and prediction. Among inherited and acquired cardiomyopathies, hypertrophic (HCM) and transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) best exemplify this opportunity. Both remain systematically underdiagnosed, span a continuous phenotypic spectrum, and are increasingly actionable through disease-modifying therapies. Emerging AI approaches applied to multimodality data streams can identify latent disease, quantify its severity, and predict its trajectory. Beyond diagnosis, AI paves the path for opportunistic screening, longitudinal surveillance, risk stratification, and novel clinical trial designs. Realizing this promise requires careful attention to label quality, generalizability, false-positive burden in low-prevalence settings, and prospective evidence that the human-AI synergy improves outcomes. In this review, we use HCM and ATTR-CM as key examples to synthesize the current evidence of AI in cardiomyopathies and propose a forward-looking framework for AI-guided disease phenotyping, with emphasis on regulation, implementation, and clinical evaluation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] 心肌病的管理依赖于及时诊断、精确表型分型、多模式风险分层和纵向监测。这些任务需要整合来自患者病史、心电图、影像学、生物标志物和纵向健康记录的高维信号，而这些数据流非常适合人工智能（AI）赋能的模式识别和预测。在遗传性和获得性心肌病中，肥厚型心肌病（HCM）和转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）最能体现这一机会。两者均仍存在系统性诊断不足，跨越连续的表型谱，并日益可通过疾病修饰治疗进行干预。应用于多模态数据流的新兴AI方法能够识别潜在疾病、量化其严重程度并预测其轨迹。除诊断外，AI为机会性筛查、纵向监测、风险分层和新临床试验设计铺平道路。实现这一前景需要审慎关注标签质量、泛化性、低患病率环境中的假阳性负担，以及人-AI协同改善结局的前瞻性证据。在本综述中，我们以HCM和ATTR-CM为主要示例，综合AI在心肌病中的当前证据，并提出一个AI引导疾病表型分型的前瞻性框架，重点强调监管、实施和临床评价。

abstract: [Information (Basel)] Protein post-translational modifications (PTMs), particularly phosphorylation, regulate cellular signaling, drug response, and disease-associated pathway activity. However, existing PTM resources are largely static and do not capture how PTM regulation varies across drug, dose, time, cellular context, and modified site. We present DrugPTM-Bench, a curated benchmark derived from decryptM dose-dependent PTM measurements, standardizing site-level drug response across seven cancer cell lines, 27 drugs, 11,167 proteins, six time points, 16 dosage levels, and pEC50 potency values. Reflecting the central role of phosphorylation in drug-responsive signaling, DrugPTM-Bench is phosphorylation-dominant, with 99.5% phosphorylation events. We formulate a protein-disjoint out-of-distribution classification task to predict whether a PTM site is up-regulated, downr-egulated, or unchanged following drug treatment. Our results show that drug-induced PTM regulation is a highly imbalanced and context-dependent prediction problem: baseline machine learning and deep learning models fail to robustly recover rare regulated events, while standard rebalancing strategies improve recall only at the cost of precision and overall F1-score. Beyond classification, DrugPTM-Bench enables pEC50 regression, mechanism-of-action prediction from PTM fingerprints, and drug-specific PTM-site sensitivity ranking.
zh_abstract: [Information (Basel)] 蛋白质翻译后修饰（PTMs），尤其是磷酸化，调控细胞信号传导、药物反应和疾病相关通路活性。然而，现有 PTM 资源在很大程度上是静态的，未能捕捉 PTM 调控如何随药物、剂量、时间、细胞背景和修饰位点而变化。我们提出 DrugPTM-Bench，这是一个源自 decryptM 剂量依赖性 PTM 测量的精选基准，标准化了七个癌细胞系、27 种药物、11,167 种蛋白质、六个时间点、16 个剂量水平和 pEC50 效力值上的位点级药物反应。反映磷酸化在药物响应性信号传导中的核心作用，DrugPTM-Bench 以磷酸化为主，包含 99.5% 的磷酸化事件。我们制定了一个蛋白质不相交的分布外分类任务，以预测 PTM 位点在药物治疗后是上调、下调还是不变。我们的结果表明，药物诱导的 PTM 调控是一个高度不平衡且依赖背景的预测问题：基线机器学习和深度学习模型无法稳健地召回罕见调控事件，而标准重平衡策略仅以精确率和总体 F1 分数为代价来提高召回率。除分类外，DrugPTM-Bench 还支持 pEC50 回归、基于 PTM 指纹的作用机制预测以及药物特异性 PTM 位点敏感性排序。

abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.
zh_abstract: 环境式人工智能（AI）记录员（ambient AI scribes）已迅速从实验性试点转向在卫生系统中全企业范围部署，有望减轻文书负担并改善临床医生体验。尽管评估这些工具的研究迅速增多，但尚无公认的方案或标准化指标来评估其性能，这使得不同研究的发现难以比较，也难以累积综合证据。在 54 项近期评估研究中，我们识别出十个评估维度和 40 个不同指标，并以 96 种不同方式操作化——其中 35 个（36%）仅被一项研究使用。评估以文书效率和时间为重点，54 项研究中有 44 项测量了这些内容。其他维度的出现率大致相似（每项 16–24 项研究），而安全性和临床结局在所有维度中最不一致。对更广泛照护系统的连锁影响，例如对患者照护结局的影响、工作再分配、计费与编码强度的变化，以及其他临床医生对病历记录的下游使用，很少被评估。此外，所用指标严重依赖自我报告，且碎片化、操作化不一致，这限制了可比性并阻碍了跨研究综合。为支持更严谨和累积性的评估，本文综述了常用于评估医疗环境中环境式 AI 记录员的研究设计、数据来源和指标，讨论了当前评估实践的局限，并主张采用基于标准化、多维指标集的更整体性方法。

abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Contrast-enhanced and non-contrast computed tomography (CECT/NCCT) are widely used in various clinical scenarios. CECT-to-NCCT synthesis enables NCCT images to be directly generated from CECT images. This streamlines clinical workflows, reduces radiation exposure risk, and prevents co-registration errors. However, to learn the mapping relationship between CECT and NCCT images, existing CECT-to-NCCT synthesis methods typically require supervised settings, which are reliant on substantial paired data. In this paper, we propose a structural preservation diffusion generation (SPDG) method for zero-shot CECT-to-NCCT synthesis. SPDG does not rely on paired data and can be implemented on a pretrained vanilla diffusion model, utilizing an inference-only process to generate NCCT images. Specifically, our SPDG is a guided diffusion generation method that uses the generative prior of the diffusion model and exploits structure-dependent guidance functions to achieve CECT-to-NCCT synthesis. Using guide images from CECT, we design consistency guidance and smoothness constraints as guidance functions for NCCT image generation. Based on the distribution characteristics of the enhanced regions in CECT images, we split the image into a potential enhancement region and an intensity stable region, and designed specific consistency guiding functions for each. The SPDG method is evaluated on abdomen and head and neck datasets, and the results demonstrate that state-of-the-art performance is achieved in unsupervised CECT-to-NCCT synthesis.
zh_abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] 对比增强和非对比增强计算机断层扫描（CECT/NCCT）广泛用于各种临床场景。CECT 到 NCCT 合成能够直接从 CECT 图像生成 NCCT 图像。这简化了临床工作流程，降低了辐射暴露风险，并防止了配准错误。然而，为了学习 CECT 和 NCCT 图像之间的映射关系，现有的 CECT 到 NCCT 合成方法通常需要监督设置，依赖大量配对数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于零样本 CECT 到 NCCT 合成的结构保持扩散生成（SPDG）方法。SPDG 不依赖配对数据，并可在预训练的原始扩散模型上实现，利用仅推理过程生成 NCCT 图像。具体而言，我们的 SPDG 是一种引导式扩散生成方法，利用扩散模型的生成先验，并利用结构依赖引导函数来实现 CECT 到 NCCT 合成。使用来自 CECT 的引导图像，我们设计了一致性引导和平滑性约束作为 NCCT 图像生成的引导函数。基于 CECT 图像中增强区域的分布特征，我们将图像划分为潜在增强区域和强度稳定区域，并为每个区域设计了特定的一致性引导函数。SPDG 方法在腹部和头颈部数据集上进行了评估，结果表明在无监督 CECT 到 NCCT 合成中达到了最先进性能。

title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
zh_title: ProTEUS：突变分辨的闭环蛋白质进化世界模型
summary: 预印本提出基于突变偏置注意力的蛋白质世界模型，并结合快速全原子预测器指导突变探索。

以突变为动作预测功能后果

abstract: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. Thus, a central challenge is to efficiently traverse the large combinatorial space of mutations in silico. We introduce ProTEUS, a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution. Pretrained on deep mutational scanning assays, ProTEUS learns a joint representation of sequence, evolutionary, and structural information using MutationFormer, a mutation-biased attention architecture. Variants are represented as states in this joint latent space, and mutations define actions whose functional consequences are predicted. To support exploration of many mutants, we developed a fast, physics-constrained all-atom predictor that utilizes explicit geometric constraint enforcement to achieve >10 fold increase in speed than AlphaFold3 with guaranteed physical validity. Lastly, ProTEUS refines its prediction and understanding of protein activity through closed loop experimental feedback to guide evolution toward a desired phenotype. ProTEUS surpasses established models in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning mutation prediction tasks. We experimentally demonstrate its utility in two closed-loop multi-objective engineering campaigns on aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase, yielding variants with >10 fold higher activity than wild type. ProTEUS provides a world-model framework that connects virtual evaluation of mutational outcomes with experimental learning for efficient protein evolution.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质工程需要在崎岖的适应度景观中导航，其中微小的序列变化可能产生巨大的功能差异，但实验筛选只能采样序列空间的一小部分。因此，一个核心挑战是在计算机中高效遍历巨大的组合突变空间。我们介绍 ProTEUS，一种用于闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型。ProTEUS 在深度突变扫描测定上预训练，使用 MutationFormer——一种突变偏置注意力架构——学习序列、进化和结构信息的联合表示。变体被表示为该联合潜空间中的状态，突变定义动作，并预测其功能后果。为支持对大量突变体的探索，我们开发了一种快速的、物理约束的全原子预测器，利用显式几何约束执行，在保证物理有效性的同时，速度比 AlphaFold3 提高 >10 倍。最后，ProTEUS 通过闭环实验反馈改进其对蛋白质活性的预测和理解，以引导进化朝向所需表型。ProTEUS 在零样本和监督微调突变预测任务中均超越已有模型。我们在醛脱氢酶和果聚糖蔗糖酶（levansucrase）上的两个闭环多目标工程活动中实验证明了其效用，产生的变体活性比野生型高 >10 倍。ProTEUS 提供了一个世界模型框架，将突变结果的虚拟评估与实验学习连接起来，以实现高效的蛋白质进化。

title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
zh_title: 偏差感知预训练用于心电图心血管病检测
summary: 预印本提出自监督心电特征提取框架，用近百万条无标注12导联心电图学习，含偏差定位与跨导联关联重建两模块。
key_points: 基于近百万条无标注12导联心电图自监督预训练
偏差定位嵌入检测波形级异常偏差
AUROC最高提升6.5%、F1提升12.8%
reason: 大规模自监督预印本方法，有基线对比但未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data and can support clinicians in diverse healthcare settings. The framework has potential to improve early detection and monitoring of cardiovascular diseases, contributing to more accessible and equitable heart care.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）信号对心血管疾病（CVD）检测至关重要。当前大多数深度学习模型依赖有监督的、任务特定的训练，这限制了它们跨疾病、患者人群和采集设置进行泛化的能力。本文提出了一种自监督ECG特征提取框架，该框架从近一百万条未标注的12导联ECG记录中学习。该框架包括两个模块：偏差定位嵌入（Deviation Localization Embedding，DLE），用于检测波形层面相对于正常模式的偏差；以及关联重建嵌入（Association Reconstruction Embedding，ARE），通过偏差引导的重建来建模跨导联关联，以捕捉在多个导联中表现的异常模式。这些模块使该框架能够捕捉细微的偏差相关模式及其跨导联背景。在多个公开数据集上，即使未对预训练特征提取器进行额外微调，该框架相较先前方法最高实现6.5%的AUROC提升和12.8%的F1提升。嵌入可视化显示，学到的特征支持有意义的疾病分组和异常识别。该方法减少了对标注数据的需求，并可在多样化医疗环境中支持临床医生。该框架有潜力改善心血管疾病的早期检测和监测，促进更可及、更公平的心脏照护。

title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
zh_title: Chem World：大规模分子性质预测基准
summary: 预印本发布整合17个数据集、逾80万实例的分子性质基准，并提出物理感知建模框架。
key_points: 17个公开数据集、10类性质任务统一评测
覆盖单分子与多组分体系含药物溶解度
提出物理约束的组合式建模方法PACM
reason: 大规模公开基准具复用价值，但为预印本且尚无外部采用证据，属值得一看档
abstract: Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations, while PACM consistently improves prediction across diverse chemical systems. Chem World and our PACM-powered drug-property prediction Agent support generalizable chemical modeling and offer a foundation for AI-assisted biomedical research and drug formulation development.
zh_abstract: 分子性质预测是计算化学和药物制剂研究的基础，然而现有基准在数据集、性质和评估协议方面仍然碎片化，限制了对模型泛化能力的系统评估。我们介绍 Chem World，一个大规模基准，整合了 17 个公共数据集、超过 800,000 个分子和化学系统实例，涵盖 10 个性质赛道，覆盖单分子和多组分系统，包括药物溶解度。Chem World 提供了一个统一测试平台，用于评估跨多样化学性质的分子表示和组成建模。基于该基准，我们提出 PACM（Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling，物理感知组成建模），它将分子表示与组成感知建模和领域特定物理约束相结合。大量实验表明，分子语言模型提供了强大且可迁移的表示，而 PACM 在多样化学系统中持续改进预测。Chem World 和我们由 PACM 驱动的药物性质预测 Agent 支持可泛化的化学建模，并为 AI 辅助的生物医学研究和药物制剂开发提供基础。

title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
zh_title: Hx2Dx ARENA：对话式临床推理基准
summary: 基于1000例NEJM病例构建交互式基准，评估大模型从问诊到诊断的推理能力。
key_points: 收录1000例NEJM临床病例
模拟问诊、查体、检查至诊断全流程
指出现有静态病例评测未覆盖问诊过程
reason: 新交互式评测范式且规模较大，但为预印本、未报告外部验证。
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve expert-level diagnostic accuracy in static evaluations, where the model receives a curated vignette or case report that already condenses the diagnostically relevant findings. Such evaluations measure inference over already selected evidence; the evaluations do not account for the inquiry used to obtain it. In clinical practice, however, diagnosis is an iterative process of inquiry. Clinicians take the patient's history, or anamnesis (Hx), through targeted questioning, examine the patient, and request and interpret tests, progressively narrowing the differential until they reach a final diagnosis (Dx). We introduce Hx2Dx ARENA, an interactive benchmark of 1'000 clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). Each case is a simulated encounter that proceeds from initial presentation through history taking and physical examination to diagnostic workup. We evaluate open- and closed-source LLMs under multiple configurations. Performance varies considerably across models in the interactive setting, and every model loses diagnostic accuracy relative to the static setting, where the full case is presented upfront. The ability to ask the right questions accounts for much of both the gap between models and the loss of accuracy: diagnosis improves as questions become more targeted and build a more complete clinical picture. LLMs thus reason well once the relevant data are available but remain limited in hypothesis-driven information gathering, in knowing what to ask in order to know. Closing this gap is a prerequisite for their safe integration into real-world diagnostic workflows.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在静态评估中达到专家级诊断准确率，在静态评估中，模型接收一个精心整理的病例摘要或病例报告，其中已浓缩了诊断相关发现。此类评估衡量的是对已经选定的证据进行推理；这些评估并未考虑获取该证据所使用的询问过程。然而，在临床实践中，诊断是一个迭代的询问过程。临床医生通过有针对性的提问采集患者病史，即病史采集（anamnesis，Hx），检查患者，并申请和解读检查，逐步缩小鉴别诊断范围，直至达到最终诊断（Dx）。我们引入 Hx2Dx ARENA，一个包含来自《新英格兰医学杂志》（New England Journal of Medicine，NEJM）的 1'000 个临床病例的交互式基准。每个病例都是一次模拟诊疗过程，从初始就诊开始，经过病史采集和体格检查，到诊断性检查。我们在多种配置下评估开源和闭源 LLM。在交互式设置中，不同模型之间的表现差异相当大，并且与静态设置（一次性呈现完整病例）相比，每个模型的诊断准确率都有所下降。提出正确问题的能力在很大程度上解释了模型之间的差距和准确率的损失：随着问题变得更有针对性并构建出更完整的临床图景，诊断会得到改善。因此，LLM 一旦获得相关数据就能很好地进行推理，但在假设驱动的信息收集中仍然有限，即不知道为了获知需要问什么。缩小这一差距是将其安全整合到真实世界诊断工作流程中的先决条件。

title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
zh_title: BioXArena-Pro：生物医学ML智能体基准
summary: 含64项研究级建模任务、22种智能体配置的基准，最佳得分仅55.1分。
key_points: 涵盖八个生物医学领域64项任务
多数任务留出物种或队列等整个生物单元
最佳配置55.1分，脚手架影响接近模型本身
reason: 新基准设计严谨、任务经审计，但为预印本且未涉及临床结局。
abstract: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.
zh_abstract: 编码智能体（coding agents）越来越多地被提出作为生物医学模型的自主构建者，但现有基准规模小、接近饱和或存在信息泄露风险。我们提出BioXArena-Pro，包含来自八个生物医学领域的64项研究级建模任务，每项任务均基于一项已发表研究重建；大多数任务留出整个生物学单元（如物种或队列）。在22种智能体配置中，最佳得分是100分中的55.1分，而脚手架（scaffold）的重要性几乎与模型相当。我们针对每项任务重新运行了一种已发表方法：在已发表配方可原样适用的情况下，最佳智能体与方法打平；在重建任务上，方法落后8.2分，提示智能体通过适应新数据而获益。预训练模型（包括生物基础模型）在最强智能体使用它们时具有重要作用：禁用它们会使该智能体在这些任务上的得分下降9分。每项任务均经过多轮AI辅助审核和最终人工审查。

title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
zh_title: BRIDGE：前列腺穿刺活检配对全切片图像数据集
summary: 发布波兰肿瘤中心采集的前列腺穿刺活检配对全切片数据集，含169例患者、2607张全切片图像。
key_points: 869张玻片、169例患者、共2607张全切片图像
切片后经脱蜡与H&E染色依次数字化形成配对
面向无标记虚拟染色模型的开发与外部验证
reason: 公开配对全切片数据集有价值，但患者数有限且为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Computational approaches are increasingly being explored to streamline histopathology workflows, including label-free methods that aim to reduce reliance on chemical staining. Among these, deep learning-based label-free virtual staining uses images of unstained tissue to computationally generate stained images. Despite growing interest, model development and validation remain constrained by the scarcity of paired, clinically annotated whole-slide imaging datasets. We present BRIDGE, a dataset of prostate core-needle biopsies collected at the Prof. Franciszek Lukaszczyk Oncology Centre in Bydgoszcz, Poland. The dataset comprises 869 glass slides from 169 patients, each digitized sequentially after sectioning, deparaffinization, and hematoxylin and eosin staining, yielding in total 2607 whole-slide images. The dataset supports the development and external validation of label-free virtual staining, virtual unstaining, image-registration and segmentation methods. Each slide is accompanied by a Gleason score, enabling downstream analyses of cancer classification and grading concordance. The stained images can be used independently for color normalization and cross-scanner robustness studies. All images are de-identified, distributed in their native scanner format and will be available through the BioImage Archive.
zh_abstract: 人们日益探索计算方法以简化组织病理学工作流程，包括旨在减少对化学染色依赖的无标记方法。其中，基于深度学习的无标记虚拟染色利用未染色组织图像通过计算生成染色图像。尽管兴趣日益增长，模型开发和验证仍受限于配对且具有临床标注的全切片成像数据集的稀缺。我们提出BRIDGE，这是一个在波兰比得哥什的Franciszek Lukaszczyk教授肿瘤中心（Prof. Franciszek Lukaszczyk Oncology Centre）采集的前列腺穿刺活检数据集。该数据集包含来自169名患者的869张玻璃载玻片，每张载玻片在切片、脱蜡和苏木精-伊红染色后依次数字化，共产生2607张全切片图像。该数据集支持无标记虚拟染色、虚拟去染色、图像配准和分割方法的开发与外部验证。每张切片均附带Gleason评分，从而支持癌症分类和分级一致性的下游分析。染色图像可独立用于颜色归一化和跨扫描仪鲁棒性研究。所有图像均已去标识化，以原生扫描仪格式分发，并将通过BioImage Archive提供。

title: Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation
zh_title: 解剖检查与诊断推理交错的可解释报告生成
summary: ARIVE 将解剖区域检查与诊断推理交错，基于 MIMIC-CXR 构建 15.9 万条多模态思维链轨迹训练报告生成模型。
key_points: 解剖检查与诊断推理交错，提升报告可追溯性
构建 159,416 条 MIMIC-CXR 多模态思维链轨迹
以解剖与临床内容奖励优化，临床效力优于基线
reason: 新方法加大规模思维链数据构建，但仅 MIMIC-CXR 单库评估，属预印本档
abstract: Automated radiology report generation can draft clinically plausible reports, yet the pathway from visual evidence to reported findings remains opaque, leaving the diagnostic basis of these reports unexplained and the generated reports difficult to review or revise. We introduce ARIVE (Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence), an explainable report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning prior to final report composition. To support this process, we constructed 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) trajectories from MIMIC-CXR, wherein visual evidence from inspected anatomical regions informs subsequent clinical interpretation. Trained on these trajectories and further optimized using anatomical and clinical-content rewards, ARIVE achieved superior clinical-efficacy performance compared with strong baselines on MIMIC-CXR and the abnormality-centered MIMIC-ABN. ARIVE's reports were competitive with those of leading models in blinded expert grading, and its MCoT trajectories earned high ratings for diagnostic traceability. Furthermore, a paired review evaluation suggests that access to MCoT can aid in identifying errors within generated reports.
zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成可以起草临床上看似合理的报告，但从视觉证据到报告发现的路径仍不透明，使这些报告的诊断依据无法解释，且生成的报告难以审阅或修改。我们引入 ARIVE（Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence），这是一个可解释的报告生成框架，在最终报告撰写之前将解剖检查与诊断推理交错进行。为支持这一过程，我们从 MIMIC-CXR 构建了 159,416 条多模态思维链（MCoT）轨迹，其中来自所检查解剖区域的视觉证据为后续临床解读提供信息。在这些轨迹上训练并使用解剖学和临床内容奖励进一步优化后，ARIVE 在 MIMIC-CXR 和以异常为中心的 MIMIC-ABN 上相比强基线取得了更优的临床效能表现。在盲法专家评分中，ARIVE 的报告与领先模型的报告具有竞争力，其 MCoT 轨迹在诊断可追溯性方面获得高评分。此外，一项配对评审评估表明，能够访问 MCoT 有助于识别生成报告中的错误。

title: SepsisFlow: an event-stream foundation model for continuous risk warning and trajectory modelling in ICU sepsis
zh_title: SepsisFlow：ICU 脓毒症连续风险预警与病程建模基础模型
summary: SepsisFlow 结合预训练 Mamba 与树模型做脓毒症前预警，并在发病时与发病后建模病程轨迹。
key_points: 基于 257 万份电子病历预训练 Mamba 编码器
同一小时时间轴覆盖发病前、发病时、发病后
MIMIC-IV 上等报警量时检出多于 NEWS2、qSOFA、SIRS
reason: 大样本预训练并对比传统评分，但仅 MIMIC-IV 内部评估，属预印本上限档
abstract: Sepsis is a leading cause of ICU death with heterogeneous onset and course, yet most warning models predict only whether sepsis will occur, leaving clinicians uncertain of its onset context and early trajectory once an alarm sounds. To answer these questions on one hourly clock from ICU admission, we built SepsisFlow: before onset, it combines a Mamba model pretrained on 2.57 million EHRs with about 1,700 hourly features in gradient-boosted trees to predict 6/12/24-h risk; at onset, it fuses Mamba and tabular encoders via a gated network into continuous patient states defining onset contexts; after onset, it encodes 72-h organ-support and physiological trajectories via an attention bidirectional recurrent network into early courses. For pre-onset warning in MIMIC-IV, SepsisFlow detected more cases than NEWS2, qSOFA, and SIRS at equal alarms, gaining about 8 cases per 100 from hourly updating, while outperforming 16 retrained algorithms and maintaining risk ranking in eICU. At onset, its contexts separated 2% cardiovascular-ICU from 15%-17% other 28-day mortality, and within each context after onset, persistent support carried fivefold higher mortality than de-escalation. SepsisFlow establishes a foundation-model paradigm for continuous risk and trajectory stratification in critical care.
zh_abstract: 脓毒症是ICU死亡的主要原因，其发病和病程具有异质性，然而大多数预警模型仅预测脓毒症是否会发生，使临床医生在警报响起后仍不确定其发病情境和早期轨迹。为了以ICU入科为起点、按每小时一个时间步的统一时钟回答这些问题，我们构建了SepsisFlow：发病前，它将一个在257万份EHR上预训练的Mamba模型与梯度提升树中约1,700个逐小时特征相结合，以预测6/12/24小时风险；发病时，它通过门控网络将Mamba和表格编码器融合为定义发病情境的连续患者状态；发病后，它通过注意力双向循环网络将72小时器官支持和生理轨迹编码为早期病程。在MIMIC-IV的发病前预警中，SepsisFlow在相同警报数量下检测到比NEWS2、qSOFA和SIRS更多的病例，通过逐小时更新每100例中约多检出8例，同时优于16种重新训练的算法，并在eICU中保持风险排序。发病时，其情境可将28天死亡率为2%的心血管ICU人群与死亡率为15%-17%的其他人群区分开；在发病后的每个情境内，持续器官支持者的死亡率是降阶梯者的五倍。SepsisFlow为重症监护中的连续风险和轨迹分层建立了一种基础模型范式。

title: Predicting Single-Cell Spatial Gene Expression from H&E using Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: 用病理基础模型从H&E预测单细胞空间基因表达
summary: 预印本系统评估病理基础模型适配策略，在配对H&E与Xenium 5K数据上做单细胞空间基因表达预测，基因层面平均相关提升2.67倍。
key_points: 使用配对H&E与Xenium 5K数据评估
基因层面平均Pearson相关提升2.67倍

abstract: Predicting gene expression directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images offers a scalable and cost-effective approach to deriving spatial molecular insights from routine histology. Pathology foundation models, typically pretrained using tile-level objectives, may not adequately capture the fine-grained cellular features required for single-cell molecular prediction. In this work, we systematically evaluate and establish domain-informed and task-specific strategies for adapting pathology foundation models to single-cell spatial gene expression prediction. Using paired H&E and Xenium 5K data, our approach improves mean gene-wise Pearson correlation by 2.67x over the standard zero-shot baseline and achieves state-of-the-art performance on this task. We demonstrate strong gene-detection performance across the full gene panel (AUROC = 0.800) and importantly identify that predictive performance varies substantially across biological contexts, with our model achieving its highest Pearson correlation for spatially variable genes (r = 0.643). Our findings demonstrate that, despite the challenges of sparse single-cell measurements, H&E-derived representations can recover biologically meaningful spatial expression patterns, highlighting both the opportunities and limitations of morphology-based molecular inference at cellular resolution.

abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Medical artificial intelligence (AI) is advancing at unprecedented speed, yet the dominant question in the field, how well does a model perform, diverges from what clinicians ask of it in practice. Did it help someone survive? In this Position Paper, we argue that a misalignment exists between how the AI community evaluates success and how clinicians define value. Even the strongest randomized trials of clinical large language models measure subspecialist preference rather than patient survival, and in a 2024 scoping review of 86 randomized trials of AI in clinical practice, only 17% had a primary endpoint related to patient symptoms or behavior. Surveys of clinicians point to a further dimension that no benchmark captures, the erosion of human connection between clinician and patient. We propose a life-centered evaluation framework built on five principles, namely outcome primacy, dynamic evaluation, clinician co-design, relational outcomes, and transparent failure publication. The measure that ultimately matters is whether a system keeps a patient out of the intensive care unit, prevents a resuscitation, or spares a family a preventable loss.

abstract: [ChemMedChem] The present article traces the long journey of the historical evolution and transformation of QSAR from its early days to its current role in drug discovery. It begins with the breakthrough created by the introduction of data analysis and highlights the major advances achieved throughout its development. Changes in molecular representation resulted in an explosion of molecular descriptors, while the rapid accumulation of large amounts of data demanded the application of elaborated statistical techniques. Today, machine learning and artificial intelligence have become integral components of pharmaceutical research, supporting every stage of the drug discovery pipeline, from target identification and hit discovery to lead optimization and the prediction of ADMET properties. At the same time, strict prerequisites have been established to ensure the development of QSAR models capable of reliable and robust predictions. Model validation, applicability domain, and model interpretability are fundamental principles of robust QSAR modeling. These principles are closely related to the distinction between local and global models, reflecting the trade-off between predictive performance, generalizability, and mechanistic interpretability. Finally, multi-objective optimization is discussed, as an approach to address the complex and often conflicting requirements, associated with successful drug candidates and decision-making throughout the drug discovery pipeline, including library design.

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] The purpose of this study is to develop an explainable deep learning framework for region-wise, multi-label assessment of inner- and middle-ear status on temporal-bone computed tomography (CT). The framework used a ResNet-18 encoder with class-specific attention pooling to predict eight labels representing normal and congenital malformation states of the left and right inner and middle ears. Sparse polygon annotations supervised attention using masked binary cross-entropy, Dice-overlap, and outside-mask penalties. A left-right equivariant consistency regularizer enforced bilateral symmetry under horizontal flipping. The dataset comprised 2399 axial and coronal CT images from 87 patients. Development used fourfold patient-level cross-validation on 35 patients (1018 images), followed by evaluation on a held-out internal test set of 52 patients (1381 images). In cross-validation, the full model achieved a macro-AUC of 0.765 and a macro-F1 of 0.627. On the held-out internal test set, image-level evaluation yielded a macro-AUC of 0.688 and a macro-F1 of 0.572, representing the highest mean performance among the evaluated CNN, vision transformer, and MedViT baselines. Patient-level aggregation further yielded a macro-AUC of 0.716 and a macro-F1 of 0.621. The proposed attention maps were also more side-specific and anatomically concentrated than baseline heatmaps. Attention supervision and bilateral equivariance may improve interpretable temporal-bone CT assessment. Larger external studies and patient-level evaluation are required before clinical deployment.

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Cancer metabolism is highly plastic, and most attempts to turn that plasticity into a therapeutic target fail for a specific, recurring reason: a computational prediction of a metabolic vulnerability is not the same evidentiary object as an experimentally confirmed one, and the two are routinely discussed as if they were interchangeable. This review takes that distinction as its starting point rather than its conclusion. Artificial intelligence and genome-scale systems biology have made it easy to generate metabolic hypotheses at a scale no experimental program could match - machine learning models trained on genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data now output candidate vulnerabilities, biomarkers, and drug combinations faster than they can be tested - but the resulting literature has not been consistently honest about how far any given prediction has actually traveled toward clinical relevance. We examine six areas where this gap is most visible: multi-omics data integration, genome-scale metabolic network modeling, computational discovery of metabolic vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal interactions, single-cell and spatial resolution of metabolic heterogeneity, AI-guided drug and biomarker discovery, and the small set of studies that have actually reached clinical testing. Rather than summarizing these areas as separate literatures, we grade every substantive finding discussed against an explicit four-tier evidence standard - associative, mechanistic, perturbation-validated, or clinically tested - and we apply that standard critically rather than deferentially: several widely cited computational vulnerabilities remain unconfirmed outside the cell lines in which they were discovered, genome-scale models continue to carry unresolved gaps in reaction coverage that limit their predictive reach, and, of the AI-derived metabolic predictions discussed in this review, only one has so far been tested in a completed prospective clinical trial. We argue that this shortage of prospective validation, not a shortage of computational sophistication, is the field's central constraint, and we close by identifying where methodological effort would do the most good: standardized validation reporting, tissue-resolved rather than bulk metabolic models, and closer coupling between computational prediction and the specific experimental designs capable of falsifying it.

abstract: Summary: Identifying epigenetically modified bases (e.g., methylation) is crucial for many important applications such as discovering mechanisms of cancer development, cell differentiation, and bacterial defense. Nanopore sequencing generates electrical signals that can differentiate canonical bases from modified ones. To detect base modifications from signals, machine learning (ML) methods and statistical approaches are commonly used. These methods can either detect a specific modification type or require an additional unmodified copy of the same DNA as a control group. However, no released model detects modification types beyond those it was trained for, which makes it difficult to detect rare modification types without an unmodified control. Our goal is to accurately identify the presence of modified sites regardless of their modification type, which we define as modification-agnostic detection. To this end, we propose RawMod, a transformer-based modification-agnostic and control-free method for detecting epigenetically modified genomic positions. The key idea of RawMod is to compare the raw signals of many reads at each site with the unmodified reference sequence, using a small model that learns many modification types as a single modified class. Based on our extensive evaluations on the detection of various modification types (5mC, 5hmC, 4mC, 6mA, and 5hmU) using various genomes, RawMod achieves the highest mean AUROC across modifications compared to control-based methods and control-free modification models. A single RawMod model with 0.23M parameters detects five modification types with a mean AUROC of 0.964, against 0.799 for the best released model. When a modification type is withheld from training, RawMod still detects it (AUROC 0.91--0.98), provided another modification of the same base was seen in training. We use RawMod to map 5hmU without a control across a 7.7 Mb contig of the Amphidinium carterae genome, consistent with two published trends. Further, we show that the modification-aware embeddings from RawMod can be used to differentiate read origin (e.g., cell types, tumor/normal origin, and native/PCR-amplified DNA).
