title: Leveraging state-of-the-art AI structure predictors to generate atomic resolution ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins
zh_title: 用结构预测AI生成无序蛋白原子级构象系综
summary: 预印本将bAIes框架扩展至AlphaFold2/3、Boltz-1/2、ESMFold等六种结构预测工具，生成天然无序蛋白的原子级构象系综。
key_points: 基于预测残基间距离分布生成构象系综
覆盖六种主流结构预测工具
不同工具生成的系综精度与实验数据相当
reason: 方法学预印本，扩展已有框架并系统比较，属值得一看档
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are central to many biological processes, but their function depends on dynamic conformational ensembles rather than a single structure. Despite the impact of artificial intelligence on protein structure prediction, determining these ensembles at atomistic resolution remains challenging. Recently, we introduced bAIes, a framework that leverages the structural information encoded in AlphaFold2 distograms to generate conformational ensembles of IDPs at atomistic resolution. Here, we extend this framework to six state-of-the-art structure prediction tools (AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, Boltz-1, Boltz-2, ESMFold, and ESMFold2) and systematically compare the structural information encoded in their predicted inter-residue distance distributions. Despite differences between predictors, we show that bAIes generates ensembles with comparable accuracy against experimental NMR and SAXS data, and competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art all-atom simulations and alternative IDP ensemble generation methods. These results demonstrate that bAIes is robust to the choice of structure predictor and that the distance distributions generated by different deep learning architectures contain valuable information about the conformational preferences of disordered proteins. More broadly, our work highlights the potential of combining AI-derived structural information with physics-based modeling to generate atomistic ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins and regions.
zh_abstract: 内在无序蛋白（IDPs）是许多生物过程的核心，但其功能取决于动态构象系综而非单一结构。尽管人工智能对蛋白质结构预测产生了影响，但以原子分辨率确定这些系综仍然具有挑战性。最近，我们提出了bAIes，这是一个利用AlphaFold2距离分布图（distograms）中编码的结构信息，以原子分辨率生成IDPs构象系综的框架。在此，我们将该框架扩展到六种最先进的结构预测工具（AlphaFold2、AlphaFold3、Boltz-1、Boltz-2、ESMFold和ESMFold2），并系统比较了其预测的残基间距离分布中所编码的结构信息。尽管不同预测器之间存在差异，我们表明bAIes生成的系综相对于实验NMR和SAXS数据具有可比的准确性，并且相对于最先进的全原子模拟和替代性IDP系综生成方法具有竞争力。这些结果表明，bAIes对结构预测器的选择具有稳健性，并且不同深度学习架构生成的距离分布包含关于无序蛋白构象偏好的有价值信息。更广泛地说，我们的工作凸显了将AI衍生的结构信息与基于物理的建模相结合，以生成内在无序蛋白和区域的原子系综的潜力。

title: DE-Rigor-Agent: An Agentic Workflow for Assumption-Aware Differential Expression Analysis of Bulk RNA-seq Data
zh_title: 面向bulk RNA-seq的假设感知差异表达分析智能体
summary: 提出DE-Rigor-Agent，按输入标准化、方法筛选、方法执行三阶段自动完成差异表达分析。
key_points: 三阶段工作流组织差异表达分析
执行前评估六种方法的适用假设
在140个模拟数据集14类场景评估
reason: 预印本方法，有模拟数据评估但无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Differential expression (DE) methods for bulk RNA-seq differ in their statistical assumptions, input data requirements, and supported study designs. Large language model (LLM) agents can automate DE analysis, but they may default to popular methods without checking whether these methods are appropriate for the data. We introduce DE-Rigor-Agent, an assumption-aware agent that organizes DE analysis into three stages: input standardization, method filtering, and method execution. Before executing any DE method, the agent uses expert-curated criteria and dataset-specific diagnostics to evaluate six commonly used methods, documents the reasons for retaining or excluding each method, and executes all retained methods. We evaluated DE-Rigor-Agent on 140 simulated datasets spanning 14 challenging scenarios involving small sample sizes, zero inflation, expression outliers, pre-normalized inputs, and confounded batch effects. Benchmarks showed that method-dataset incompatibilities could lead to inflated false discovery rates (FDRs) or reduced statistical power. Two general-purpose LLM agent baselines, including one explicitly prompted to consider statistical assumptions, selected DESeq2 or edgeR for nearly all datasets. In contrast, DE-Rigor-Agent's filtering decisions closely matched the incompatibilities introduced in the simulations and remained consistent across random seeds, with little additional computational cost. These results demonstrate that DE-Rigor-Agent provides an automated approach to assessing method suitability, making DE analysis more rigorous and transparent.
zh_abstract: 用于批量 RNA-seq 的差异表达（DE）方法在其统计假设、输入数据要求和所支持的研究设计方面各不相同。大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以自动化 DE 分析，但它们可能默认采用流行方法，而不检查这些方法是否适合数据。我们引入 DE-Rigor-Agent，一个具有假设感知能力的智能体，将 DE 分析组织为三个阶段：输入标准化、方法过滤和方法执行。在执行任何 DE 方法之前，该智能体使用专家制定的标准和数据集特异性诊断来评估六种常用方法，记录保留或排除每种方法的理由，并执行所有保留的方法。我们在 140 个模拟数据集上评估 DE-Rigor-Agent，这些数据集涵盖 14 个具有挑战性的场景，涉及小样本量、零膨胀、表达离群值、预标准化输入和混杂批次效应。基准测试表明，方法-数据集不兼容可能导致假发现率（FDR）膨胀或统计功效降低。两个通用 LLM 智能体基线（包括一个被明确提示考虑统计假设的基线）在几乎所有数据集上都选择了 DESeq2 或 edgeR。相比之下，DE-Rigor-Agent 的过滤决策与模拟中引入的不兼容性密切匹配，并在不同随机种子下保持一致，且额外计算成本很小。这些结果表明，DE-Rigor-Agent 提供了一种自动化方法来评估方法适用性，使 DE 分析更加严谨和透明。

title: Pocket similarity guided selection of protein targets for systematic protein ligand dataset generation
zh_title: 口袋相似性指导蛋白靶点选择
summary: 以口袋相似性描述符映射人类可成药口袋组，用于构建蛋白-配体数据集。
key_points: 识别15559个蛋白上51535个预测可成药口袋
以口袋而非序列或折叠相似性选代表性靶点
服务于Target 2035开放结合数据计划
reason: 方法学预印本，为ML药物发现数据构建提供新思路，尚无验证结果。
abstract: The scarcity of large, diverse, and unbiased protein ligand binding datasets limits the performance of machine learning approaches in drug discovery, particularly for understudied proteins. The Target 2035 initiative aims to address this gap by generating open-access binding data for more than 2,000 human proteins, a goal whose value depends on maximizing the diversity of the selected targets. Because proteins with different folds can share chemically analogous binding sites, we reasoned that pocket similarity, rather than sequence or fold similarity, is the appropriate criterion for selecting representative targets that maximize coverage of the human pocketome. Here, we use PocketVec, an alignment-free descriptor of binding sites, to map the human globular pocketome, identifying 51,535 predicted druggable pockets across 15,559 proteins. A two level hierarchical clustering, first within protein families and then across the whole proteome, grouped these pockets into 1,865 clusters of chemically similar binding sites. After discarding 533 clusters containing pockets with known ligands, we selected the 100 most populated of the remaining 1,332 ligand free clusters and chose two high quality representative pockets per cluster, ranked by their resemblance to known ligand-binding sites. Finally, we implemented two complementary prioritization strategies, one favoring structurally unexplored proteins and the other proteins amenable to experimental follow up, and selected 200 pockets from 100 different clusters from each strategy, with 89 clusters in common. Both selections cover over 10,000 pockets in ~5,600 proteins, approximately 36% of the human proteins with annotated druggable pockets, which represents a 2.8- to 4.4-fold increase in the number of covered pockets, domains, and proteins than random selection baselines. This pocket based framework offers a principled strategy to select diverse targets for Target 2035 and other large scale protein ligand data generation efforts in chemical biology.
zh_abstract: 大型、多样且无偏的蛋白质-配体结合数据集的稀缺限制了机器学习方法在药物发现中的性能，尤其是对研究不足的蛋白质。Target 2035计划旨在通过为超过2,000种人类蛋白质生成开放获取的结合数据来弥补这一空白，而该目标的价值取决于能否最大化所选靶标的多样性。由于具有不同折叠的蛋白质可以共享化学上相似的结合位点，我们据此推断，口袋相似性而非序列或折叠相似性，是选择代表性靶标以最大化人类口袋组（pocketome）覆盖度的合适标准。在此，我们使用PocketVec——一种无需比对（alignment-free）的结合位点描述符——来绘制人类球状口袋组图谱，在15,559种蛋白质中识别出51,535个预测的可成药口袋。采用两级层次聚类，首先在蛋白质家族内、然后在全蛋白质组范围内，将这些口袋归入1,865个化学相似结合位点簇。在剔除533个包含具有已知配体口袋的簇后，我们从其余1,332个无配体簇中选择口袋数量最多的100个簇，并按与已知配体结合位点的相似性排序，为每个簇选择两个高质量代表性口袋。最后，我们实施两种互补的优先排序策略：一种偏向结构上尚未探索的蛋白质，另一种偏向适合实验后续研究的蛋白质；每种策略从100个不同簇中选择200个口袋，两种选择共有89个簇相同。两种选择共覆盖约5,600种蛋白质中的超过10,000个口袋，约占具有注释可成药口袋的人类蛋白质的36%，相比随机选择基线，覆盖的口袋、结构域和蛋白质数量增加了2.8至4.4倍。这一基于口袋的框架为Target 2035以及化学生物学中其他大规模蛋白质-配体数据生成工作选择多样化靶标提供了有原则的策略。

title: The Confessions of a Protein Language Model: Steering, Activations, and What Predicted Confidence Cannot Certify
zh_title: 蛋白质语言模型的审计：引导、激活与置信度局限
summary: 预印本审计蛋白质生成筛选流程中的重复度引导、ESMFold置信度与激活读出是否真正对应预期目标。
key_points: 引导在操作点保持置信度，但存在阈值崩塌
未引导激活可预测置信度门控，ROC-AUC约0.786
预测门控不等同于可折叠性，稳定性未超随机
reason: 对蛋白质语言模型常用读出的严谨审计，方法有新意但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein generate-and-screen pipelines use interventions and readouts to select candidates, but rarely test whether these track their intended targets. We audit published repetition steering, ESMFold confidence, and an activation readout. Steering preserves confidence at its operating point, but a fitted cliff follows at alpha_50 = 1.240x (sweep's own control: 64.0%). Direction matters at moderate matched-norm push, but not at saturation. Unsteered generator activations predict the confidence gate (ROC-AUC 0.786 +/- 0.004), supporting cost-aware, model-specific triage. We also replicate established length sensitivity, through which shortening can manufacture false nulls. Yet on composition- and length-matched design--scramble pairs, no balanced-accuracy interval excludes chance for experimental stability. Predicting the gate does not establish foldability. We should test what a readout measures before using it to select. Code and data: https://github.com/paninishah/plm-steering-audit
zh_abstract: 蛋白质生成-筛选流程（protein generate-and-screen pipelines）使用干预和读出指标来选择候选物，但很少检验这些指标是否追踪其预期靶标。我们审计了已发表的重复引导（repetition steering）、ESMFold 置信度和一种激活读出指标。引导在其工作点保持置信度，但在 alpha_50 = 1.240x 时出现拟合的悬崖（该扫描自身对照：64.0%）。方向在中等匹配范数推动下重要，但在饱和时不重要。未引导的生成器激活可预测置信度门控（ROC-AUC 0.786 +/- 0.004），支持成本感知的、模型特异性分诊。我们还复现了已确立的长度敏感性，通过这种敏感性，缩短可制造虚假零结果。然而，在组成和长度匹配的设计——打乱配对（design--scramble pairs）上，没有平衡准确率区间能排除实验稳定性的随机机会。预测门控并不能确立可折叠性。我们应在使用读出指标进行选择之前，检验它测量的是什么。代码和数据：https://github.com/paninishah/plm-steering-audit

title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
zh_title: EM-DETR：基于示例定位的医学病灶基础检测模型
summary: 预印本提出学生-教师训练整合标注体系异构的医学影像数据集，构建多领域病灶检测基础模型。
key_points: 用学生-教师策略合并异构标签空间数据集
缓解灾难性遗忘并改善特征学习
扩展示例驱动的EM-DETR进行联合学习
reason: 预印本提出新训练与检测框架，但未见外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.
zh_abstract: 基于深度学习（DL）的计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在支持临床医生方面已显示出巨大前景，但其性能在很大程度上取决于大型、注释良好的数据集的可用性。在医学病变检测中，全面、标准化注释的稀缺以及现有数据集的异质性限制了稳健基础模型的发展。在这项工作中，我们引入一种新方法，通过整合针对解剖结构和异常均进行注释的多样医学图像数据集，构建用于病变检测的多域基础模型。我们首先提出一种学生-教师训练策略，以有效结合具有异质标签空间的数据集，减轻灾难性遗忘并改进特征学习。此外，在我们先前提出的基于示例的 EM-DETR 框架基础上，我们对其进行调整，使其能够联合学习多个领域特定数据集，从而实现跨模态的细粒度、示例驱动检测。我们的模型取得了最先进（state-of-the-art, SOTA）结果，在 CXR 的四项关键发现上，图像级 AUC 分数超过先前 SOTA 1 个百分点。我们在 CXR 和乳腺摄影中取得了领先的 mAP50，超过在单一数据集上训练的 EM-DETR 2-3 个百分点。这种方法为医学影像中可扩展的基础模型铺平了道路，这些模型利用异质数据，同时保持稳健且可泛化的性能。

title: CLADE: Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
zh_title: CLADE：证据粒度不足时的类别级作答
summary: 预印本提出检索增强模型在仅检索到粗粒度类别证据时直接作答的现象CLADE，并在生物医学问题上评测。
key_points: 定义“可解析的不足”这一检索证据情形
发现模型倾向作答而非弃答或再检索
在生物医学问答上进行评测
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，聚焦生物医学问答，证据有限
abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems often retrieve passages that are accurate and relevant but state the answer at a coarser level of granularity than the question requires. For example, a question may ask which specific disease a drug treats (familial hyperlipidemia), while the retrieved passage mentions the broader disease family (hyperlipidemia). Prior work on context sufficiency treats such coarse passages simply as insufficient. We argue that they form a distinct case, which we call resolvable insufficiency: text alone cannot settle the fine-grained answer, but the broader category it mentions maps to a short list of candidate answers in a domain ontology. When language models read these coarse, family-only passages, they exhibit a phenomenon we call Clade (Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence): they answer instead of abstaining or searching further. On biomedical questions from PrimeKG, family-only passages reduce abstention by 13.8 points compared to uninformative passages, and the resulting guesses are wrong about half the time. A counterfactual test confirms the cause: replacing an exact disease name with its broader family name lowers abstention by 17.4 points compared to deleting the sentence. Simple fixes like confidence filtering, scaling to a larger model, and explicitly instructing the model to abstain cannot resolve Clade, and this replicates on ecological species interactions in GloBI. Finally, we test whether an ontology can turn coarse passages into exact answers. Given the correct family, an ontology list includes the true answer in 98.5% of cases, but string matching finds that family on the page for only 19.8%. Letting the model choose the family raises this to 30.0% and end-to-end recovery from 10.0% to 26.8%. Overall, our results show when language models should stop guessing and consult an ontology, and highlight which steps of that process remain unsolved.
zh_abstract: 检索增强系统常常检索到准确且相关的段落，但其陈述答案的粒度比问题所要求的更粗。例如，问题可能询问某种药物可治疗哪种特定疾病（家族性高脂血症），而检索到的段落却提到更宽泛的疾病家族（高脂血症）。此前关于上下文充分性的工作将此类粗粒度段落简单视为不充分。我们认为它们构成一种不同的情形，称之为可解决的不足（resolvable insufficiency）：仅凭文本无法确定细粒度答案，但其提到的更宽泛类别可映射到领域本体中的一小份候选答案列表。当语言模型阅读这些仅含家族的粗粒度段落时，它们表现出我们称之为 Clade（Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence，缺陷证据下的类别级作答）的现象：它们给出答案，而不是弃答或进一步检索。在来自 PrimeKG 的生物医学问题上，与无信息段落相比，仅含家族的段落使弃答率降低 13.8 个百分点，而由此产生的猜测约有一半是错误的。反事实测试证实了原因：与删除句子相比，用更宽泛的家族名称替换确切疾病名称使弃答率降低 17.4 个百分点。简单的修复方法，如置信度过滤、扩大到更大模型以及明确指示模型弃答，都无法解决 Clade，并且这一点在 GloBI 的生态物种相互作用上得到复现。最后，我们测试本体能否将粗粒度段落转化为确切答案。给定正确的家族，本体列表在 98.5% 的情况下包含真实答案，但字符串匹配仅在 19.8% 的页面上找到该家族。让模型选择家族可将这一比例提高到 30.0%，并将端到端恢复率从 10.0% 提高到 26.8%。总体而言，我们的结果表明语言模型应在何时停止猜测并查阅本体，并突出该过程中哪些步骤仍未解决。

title: What Factors Matter for Collection-Level Counting with Human-AI Collaboration?
zh_title: 人机协作的集合级计数中哪些因素重要
summary: 在12项任务（含生物医学显微图像）中比较模型、估计器与适配策略对人机协作集合级计数的影响。
key_points: 统一人在回路计数框架跨12个任务比较
多模态模型可作为免训练起点
微调检测器在域偏移下表现不同
reason: 方法学预印本，跨任务对比有新意但非临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Many scientific and policy decisions require estimating the total number of target objects across a large image collection. Exhaustive human labeling is often infeasible, while raw model predictions can be biased, especially under domain shift. Recent human-AI estimation methods combine imperfect model predictions with limited human verification to obtain reliable collection-level estimates. However, existing work provides little guidance on how practitioners should choose among models, estimators, and adaptation strategies for a new deployment. We study these choices within a common human-in-the-loop counting framework across 12 tasks spanning biomedical microscopy, ground-level and aerial wildlife surveys, and overhead imagery of urban structures. Our results show that modern multimodal models provide a strong, training-free starting point for many tasks, while fine-tuned detectors become more advantageous at larger labeling budgets and across repeated deployments. Estimation efficiency improves further when model predictions are used to prioritize which units humans label, rather than sampling uniformly. We also find that each model's ranking quality can be estimated with a small pilot set, yielding practical guidance for selecting strategies on new counting tasks. In a field deployment on aerial pronghorn surveys, a task-specific adaptation of these methods meets the survey's $\pm 5\%$ tolerance after reviewing a median of only $3.2\%$ of collected images.
zh_abstract: 许多科学和政策决策需要估计大型图像集合中目标对象的总数。穷尽式人工标注往往不可行，而原始模型预测可能有偏，尤其是在域偏移下。近期的人-AI估计方法将不完美的模型预测与有限的人工核验相结合，以获得可靠的集合级估计。然而，现有工作很少指导从业者在新的部署中如何在模型、估计器和适应策略之间进行选择。我们在一个共同的人在回路计数框架内，跨12项任务研究这些选择，任务涵盖生物医学显微成像、地面和航空野生动物调查以及城市结构俯视影像。我们的结果表明，现代多模态模型为许多任务提供了强大的、无需训练的起点，而微调检测器在更大的标注预算和重复部署中更具优势。当使用模型预测来确定人类标注单元的优先级，而不是均匀采样时，估计效率进一步提高。我们还发现，每个模型的排序质量可通过小规模试点集估计，为在新计数任务上选择策略提供实用指导。在航空叉角羚调查的现场部署中，这些方法的任务特定适配在仅审阅所收集图像的中位数3.2%后，就满足调查的±5%容差。

title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
zh_title: 生物医学研究智能体的决策溯源审计
summary: 预印本提出BioAgent-DF，通过在同一计算位点替换数值，检验科学智能体结论与引用证据的分离情况。
key_points: 用配对参考值与候选值检验证据溯源
八个SciFact批次中两模型出现可重复变化
完整还原可恢复证据集而结论保持不变
reason: 有新意的智能体审计预印本，仅小规模评测无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the agent on healthy hardware. Across eight SciFact batches, Qwen3.5-4B shows repeatable citation changes in three capture-claim combinations, and Gemma 3 4B IT shows repeatable read and citation changes in four. These seven combinations cover two claims. Full restoration recovers the reference evidence sets while verdicts remain unchanged. Verdict changes observed under the baseline prompt did not recur under the explicit-example prompt. Complementary tool and optimizer experiments distinguish recovery of numerical state, recovery of ranked lists, and restoration of an agent's visible history. These results show that an audit should track both the evidence an agent uses and its final answer. In hERG cardiac-safety assay allocation, silent numerical faults changed testing decisions while the fixed-budget shortlist kept the same number of compounds labeled as blockers. After the agent had used faulty values, restoring its earlier execution state and supplying certified scores recovered all 39 changed decisions, whereas replacing the prediction file recovered none; no incorrect action was committed. A streaming implementation of the arithmetic checks reduced the total time for forward execution and verification by 42.4% relative to the original FP64 implementation, with identical flags and recovery outputs.
zh_abstract: 一个科学智能体在阅读并引用不同证据时可能给出相同判定。BioAgent-DF 使用保存在同一科学计算位点的成对参考值和候选值来检验这种分离。它将这些值恢复或移植到其原始坐标，然后在无故障硬件上运行智能体。在八个 SciFact 批次中，Qwen3.5-4B 在三种捕获-主张组合中显示出可重复的引用变化，Gemma 3 4B IT 在四种组合中显示出可重复的读取和引用变化。这七种组合涵盖两个主张。完整恢复可找回参考证据集，而判定保持不变。在基线提示词下观察到的判定变化在明确示例提示词下未再出现。补充的工具和优化器实验区分了数值状态恢复、排序列表恢复以及智能体可见历史恢复。这些结果表明，审计应同时追踪智能体使用的证据及其最终答案。在 hERG 心脏安全性测定分配中，静默数值故障改变了检测决策，而固定预算候选短名单仍将相同数量的化合物标记为阻断剂。在智能体使用故障值后，恢复其较早的执行状态并提供经认证的评分可恢复全部 39 项改变的决策，而替换预测文件则未恢复任何一项；未执行任何错误操作。算术检查的流式实现相对于原始 FP64 实现将前向执行与验证的总时间减少了 42.4%，且标志和恢复输出完全相同。

title: A Concept-Based Interpretable Framework for Clinical Text-based Prediction via Token-Concept Attention without Concept Supervision
zh_title: 无概念监督的临床文本可解释预测框架
summary: 提出基于令牌-概念交叉注意力的框架，无需概念标注即可为临床文本预测提供概念级解释。
key_points: 无需概念标签的交叉注意力瓶颈
预训练语言模型嵌入文本与概念描述
输出令牌级概念相关性分数
reason: 预印本新方法，证据限于方法描述，属值得一看档。
abstract: Objective: Concept-based interpretation has emerged as a promising approach for explaining blackbox models using human-understandable, high-level concepts. However, most existing methods require annotated concept labels to train the model to identify concepts in the input, and obtaining such annotations in clinical text is often expensive. This study aims to enable concept-based interpretation for language models without concept supervision on clinical prediction tasks. Methods: We propose a novel framework that enables concept-based interpretation without concept supervision through a tailored cross-attention bottleneck. Clinical text and the text descriptions of medical concepts are first tokenized and embedded by a pretrained language model. A cross-attention module then estimates the presence of each concept for each text token, producing concept relevance scores that capture how concepts are involved throughout the note. These scores are pooled and used in a linear prediction layer to model clinical outcomes in an interpretable manner. Results: The performance of the proposed framework was compared against blackbox models across two tasks: chest trauma severity stratification using a private dataset and an in-hospital mortality prediction task using the publicly available MIMIC-III dataset. The proposed framework achieved AUROC values within 0.02 of the corresponding blackbox models. The framework also enabled cohort- and patient-level interpretation, capturing the overall concept importance across the cohort and patient-specific concept contributions. Conclusion: Our proposed framework realizes concept-based interpretation without requiring ground-truth concept presence labels. It improves the transparency of clinical text predictions while maintaining strong performance in clinical prediction tasks.
zh_abstract: 【目的】基于概念的解释已成为一种有前景的方法，可利用人类可理解的高层概念来解释黑箱模型。然而，大多数现有方法需要标注概念标签来训练模型识别输入中的概念，而在临床文本中获得此类标注往往代价高昂。本研究旨在使语言模型在临床预测任务中无需概念监督即可实现基于概念的解释。【方法】我们提出一种新颖框架，通过定制的交叉注意力瓶颈（cross-attention bottleneck）在无需概念监督的情况下实现基于概念的解释。临床文本和医学概念的文本描述首先由预训练语言模型进行分词和嵌入。随后，交叉注意力模块估计每个文本标记（token）对应的每个概念是否存在，生成概念相关性得分，以捕捉概念如何贯穿整个记录。这些得分被池化，并用于线性预测层，以可解释的方式建模临床结局。【结果】所提出框架的性能在两个任务上与黑箱模型进行比较：使用私有数据集的胸部创伤严重程度分层，以及使用公开可用的 MIMIC-III 数据集的院内死亡预测任务。所提出框架达到的 AUROC 值在相应黑箱模型的 0.02 以内。该框架还实现了队列水平和患者水平的解释，捕捉整个队列中的总体概念重要性以及患者特定的概念贡献。【结论】我们提出的框架无需真实概念存在标签即可实现基于概念的解释。它提高了临床文本预测的透明度，同时在临床预测任务中保持强劲性能。

title: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
zh_title: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割框架
summary: 预印本提出MEOW框架，将非交互分割骨干转为不更新参数的交互式开放世界学习器。
key_points: 结合无参数转导推理与记忆固化
在训练未见的类别上持续自我改进
可零样本迁移至micro-CT等其他模态
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，描述中未见量化外部验证
abstract: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.
zh_abstract: 在开放世界识别中，机器学习模型不仅对未知结构（“广义开放集”）进行预测，还会随着时间推移从这些预测中持续学习和改进。交互式分割尽管能够获得用户反馈，但迄今仍局限于开放集设定。在本工作中，我们引入MEOW，这是首个在不更新可学习模型参数的情况下将非交互式分割骨干网络转变为交互式开放世界学习器的框架。MEOW将无参数直推式推理与记忆巩固相结合，以积累知识并由此提升未来性能。聚焦医学数据，我们表明MEOW在训练期间从未见过的类别上持续改进自身预测，并能零样本迁移到不熟悉领域，包括显微CT（micro-CT）数据和其他成像模态。

title: MicroBT: Centroid-Guided Synergistic Learning for Multi-Modal Micro Brain Tumor Segmentation and Counting
zh_title: MicroBT：质心引导的多模态微小脑肿瘤分割与计数
summary: 提出质心锚定的多模态框架 MicroBT，用于亚3毫米微小脑肿瘤的分割与实例计数，以缓解基于重叠目标对大病灶的偏好。
key_points: 指出重叠类目标会系统性压制3毫米以下微小病灶
以尺度不变的病灶质心为锚点进行协同学习
同时做像素级分割与实例级计数，属预印本方法
reason: 有新意的分割计数方法预印本，缺乏外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Multi-modal brain tumor segmentation is essential for clinical diagnosis, radiotherapy planning, and longitudinal monitoring. While recent studies have achieved remarkable overall segmentation performance, they rely on overlap-based objectives that inherently favor large regions, causing sub-3 mm micro-lesions to be systematically suppressed during training. Moreover, existing pixel-level segmentation frameworks lack explicit instance-level modeling, leading to unreliable lesion counting that directly impacts clinical staging and therapeutic decisions. To address these challenges, we propose MicroBT, a unified multi-modal framework for micro brain tumor segmentation and counting. Our core insight is that a fundamental geometric property is inherently scale-invariant: regardless of size, each lesion possesses a well-defined centroid. Leveraging this, we first devise a centroid-anchored synergistic paradigm that utilizes predicted centroids as shared anchors to simultaneously condition dense segmentation and instance-level localization. To counteract the tumor size imbalance, we further devise a Volume-Calibrated Loss (VC-Loss) that adaptively amplifies the gradient contribution of micro-lesions, alongside a Size-Aware Curriculum Optimization (SACO) that stabilizes multi-task training by establishing global representations before progressively unlocking fine-grained localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroBT outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly on metastases, where micro-lesion ($\leq 3$ mm) localization precision improves by approximately 7% and counting estimation errors decrease by approximately 26%. The code is available at https://github.com/leonlou921/MicroBT.
zh_abstract: 多模态脑肿瘤分割对于临床诊断、放疗计划和纵向监测至关重要。尽管近期研究已取得显著的总体分割性能，但它们依赖基于重叠的目标函数，这些目标函数天然偏向大区域，导致小于3 mm的微小病灶在训练期间被系统性抑制。此外，现有像素级分割框架缺乏显式的实例级建模，导致病灶计数不可靠，直接影响临床分期和治疗决策。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MicroBT，一个用于微小脑肿瘤分割与计数的统一多模态框架。我们的核心洞察是，一个基本几何属性本质上是尺度不变的：无论大小如何，每个病灶都具有明确的质心。利用这一点，我们首先设计了一种以质心为锚的协同范式，利用预测质心作为共享锚点，同时为密集分割和实例级定位提供条件。为抵消肿瘤大小不平衡，我们进一步设计了体积校准损失（VC-Loss），自适应放大微小病灶的梯度贡献，并配合尺寸感知课程优化（SACO），通过在逐步解锁细粒度定位之前建立全局表示来稳定多任务训练。大量实验表明，MicroBT优于最先进方法，尤其是在转移瘤上，微小病灶（≤ 3 mm）定位精度提高约7%，计数估计误差降低约26%。代码可在https://github.com/leonlou921/MicroBT获取。

title: Performance of Claude 3.5 Sonnet Compared to Human Readers of The New England Journal of Medicine Clinical Case Challenges.
zh_title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 与人类读者解答 NEJM 病例挑战比较
summary: 在 20 例 NEJM 临床病例挑战上，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 多模态诊断准确率约半数且显著高于网站人类应答者。
key_points: 20 例 NEJM 病例，输入文本加全部图像
模型正确率约 50%，显著高于人类应答者
样本量小，比较对象为网站自愿答题者
reason: 有人机对照但仅 20 例、非临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [PRiMER (Leawood, Kan.)] Large language models (LLMs) can pass the US medical licensing exam and outperform residents on the family medicine in-training exam. The diagnostic performance of LLMs when applied to more complex medical cases, however, remains unknown. We evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of Claude (Anthropic), an LLM, on 20 case challenges published in The New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). For each case, we presented Claude 3.5 Sonnet with multimodal input, including the text and all corresponding images from the cases. Claude was instructed to give an answer among multiple choices. We compared Claude's diagnostic accuracy to human respondents on the NEJM website. Claude 3.5 Sonnet diagnosed cases correctly about half the time, and at a significantly higher rate than NEJM readers (beta-binomial odds ratio 2.79; 95% CI [profile-likelihood] 1.09-7.01; P = 0.031). Claude was highly self-consistent in repeated exposure to questions, with perfect accuracy (100%) in nine cases and no accuracy (0%) in 10 cases, with one case at 90% accuracy. Human accuracy ranged from 9%-63% across cases. Claude's performance was better on easier cases (ie, those with human accuracy >25%). Claude 3.5 Sonnet demonstrated significantly higher diagnostic accuracy compared to medical journal readers, though with notable variability in performance. Further research comparing consistency and reliability of artificially intelligent diagnostic capabilities to that of licensed physicians is needed.
zh_abstract: [PRiMER (Leawood, Kan.)] 大语言模型（LLMs）能够通过美国医师执照考试，并在家庭医学在训考试中表现优于住院医师。然而，LLMs 应用于更复杂医学病例时的诊断表现仍未知。我们在《The New England Journal of Medicine》（NEJM）发表的 20 个病例挑战中评估了大语言模型 Claude（Anthropic）的诊断准确性。对于每个病例，我们向 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 提供多模态输入，包括病例文本及所有对应图像。Claude 被指示在多个选项中选择一个答案。我们将 Claude 的诊断准确性与 NEJM 网站上的人类应答者进行了比较。Claude 3.5 Sonnet 约有一半时间正确诊断病例，且正确率显著高于 NEJM 读者（beta-binomial 优势比 2.79；95% CI [profile-likelihood] 1.09-7.01；P = 0.031）。Claude 在重复接触问题时高度自洽：9 个病例准确率为完美（100%），10 个病例准确率为零（0%），1 个病例准确率为 90%。不同病例中人类准确率范围为 9%-63%。Claude 在较容易的病例（即人类准确率 >25% 的病例）上表现更好。与医学期刊读者相比，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 表现出显著更高的诊断准确性，尽管其表现存在明显变异性。仍需进一步研究，将人工智能诊断能力的一致性和可靠性与执业医师进行比较。

title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
zh_title: FedVP：以本地验证器汇聚实现异构模型联邦学习
summary: 提出联邦验证器池范式，各机构冻结不同 LLM 主干预训练本地验证器并汇总判断，在五个医学问答数据集评估。
key_points: 不聚合参数，通过共享验证器实现异构协作
支持不同家族、不同规模 LLM，主干保持冻结
在五个公开医学问答数据集上评测
reason: 方法有新颖性且多数据集评测，但为预印本、无临床落地验证
abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.

abstract: Intraoperative scene perception in ophthalmic microsurgery is limited by instrument occlusion: when a tool enters the high-magnification field, it conceals tissue from both the surgeon and the perception components of robot-assisted systems that process the video. Generative inpainting can remove the occluder but replaces the missing image content with synthesis, which is unsuitable when visual provenance matters. Many video inpainters also depend on future frames and cannot operate online. We present TransGHOST, a causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline whose non-generative safe mode operates in real time. Every restored value is obtained by resampling a recorded frame using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions. The system provides per-pixel confidence and provenance and marks unsupported pixels as abstentions. We evaluate TransGHOST on a new veterinary clinical corpus of canine cataract surgery with pixel-level instrument and anatomy labels. Only the occluded region is scored, and each scoring target is verified to differ from the reference supplied to the system. Safe mode reaches 31.89 dB masked PSNR and 0.915 masked SSIM at 51.7 ms median and 85.5 ms 95th-percentile latency. On a pre-declared held-out cohort using instrument cutouts excluded from segmentation training, it reaches 29.83 dB masked PSNR, while matched-mask evaluation on validation shows a 3.45 dB advantage over LaMa. Region-aware reference selection improves masked PSNR by 3.60 dB over recency when candidate references can themselves be occluded. Reference-age analysis further defines the operating interval for the brief, repeated occlusions targeted by TransGHOST.

abstract: [Updates in surgery] To map the global research landscape and thematic evolution of artificial intelligence (AI)-related research in cholecystectomy and to identify major contributors, collaboration patterns, and intellectual foundations. English-language articles and reviews were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus. After deduplication and eligibility screening, 559 publications were included. Publication trends, scientific collaboration, keyword co-occurrence, conceptual structure, thematic evolution, and co-citation and citation-burst patterns were analyzed using bibliometrix, VOSviewer, and Python. Research activity increased markedly in recent years, with 424 publications (75.8%) appearing between 2022 and 2025. China contributed the largest publication output, whereas the United States received the highest total citations. Keyword and conceptual-structure analyses identified research domains involving AI and computational methods, surgical workflow and intraoperative visual analysis, and computer-vision-based applications. Thematic evolution suggested a progression from early workflow- and convolutional-neural-network-related research toward machine learning, deep learning, radiomics, surgical phase recognition, and more recent transformer-related approaches. Twinanda et al. [1] showed the strongest citation burst and occupied a prominent position in the reference co-citation network. AI-related research in cholecystectomy has expanded rapidly and become increasingly diverse in its methodological and application-oriented focus. Current bibliometric patterns suggest growing attention to workflow analysis, computer vision, surgical phase recognition, and newer model architectures. Further multicenter validation and prospective clinical evaluation are needed to determine whether these developments translate into generalizable and clinically meaningful applications.

abstract: [Cardiovascular & hematological disorders drug targets] One of the main causes of death in the world is Cardiovascular Diseases (CVDs). The number of acute myocardial infarctions and fatalities may be considerably decreased by early detection of Cardiovascular (CV) events. However, the efficacy of conventional data analysis for diagnosis and treatment is hampered by the complexity of the disease and the wide range of affecting factors. Large, multidimensional medical datasets can be processed by Artificial Intelligence (AI) owing to its sophisticated computational capabilities. This narrative review was conducted through a structured search of PubMed/ MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar to identify peer-reviewed literature on artificial intelligence in cardiovascular medicine. Relevant studies addressing diagnosis, risk stratification, prognostic prediction, cardiovascular imaging, and clinical implementation were critically evaluated with emphasis on methodological quality, external validation, clinical applicability, and implementation challenges. AI-based systems have been shown to be more effective at classifying risk, predicting outcomes, and spotting illness trends. Early diagnosis and more customized treatment plans are made possible by these algorithms' ability to examine intricate relationships in large healthcare datasets. Clinical applications have improved auxiliary diagnostic instruments and increased patient care effectiveness. AI offers more accuracy and flexibility than traditional approaches when handling high-dimensional CVD data. It may reduce the burden of disease and promote tailored treatment regimens. However, data quality, standardization, and ethical concerns for broad use remain issues. The detection and treatment of CVDs are being revolutionized by AI-powered technology. Their use in clinical settings may improve cardiovascular care and lower the number of heart disease-related deaths worldwide.

abstract: [Health science reports] The integration of medical artificial intelligence (AI) in rural India holds transformative potential for enhancing healthcare access and quality. This narrative review examines the promising applications of medical AI in addressing healthcare disparities, increasing service efficiency, and mitigating physician shortages in underserved areas. However, challenges persist, including medical students' limited awareness and education about AI, reluctance to engage in rural health services, and migration trends affecting healthcare delivery. Effective implementation demands a multifaceted approach, tackling technological, economic, and contextual obstacles through stakeholder collaboration. Ethical considerations such as bias, data privacy, and local workforce involvement are paramount for the responsible deployment of medical AI. This review delves into both the opportunities and challenges, emphasizing the importance of addressing these issues through enhanced education and ethical frameworks. Ultimately, a balanced strategy is essential to harness the potential of medical AI in revolutionizing rural healthcare, highlighting the need for innovative policies that align technological advancements with community needs.

abstract: [Dermatology and therapy] Artificial intelligence (AI) is playing an expanding role in dermatology, particularly in diagnosing skin cancer and other cutaneous diseases. However, little is known about public perceptions towards AI for skincare evaluation and management. The purpose of this study was to assess public trust, comfort, and security concerns about AI-based facial evaluation. A cross-sectional survey was administered to 147 participants through Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) and REDCap. Participants rated comfort, trust, and security concerns regarding AI and dermatologist evaluation of facial images using a 5-point Likert scale. Wilcoxon Signed-Rank tests were used to compare preference for AI vs. dermatologists. Participants expressed greater confidence in dermatologists than AI for independent evaluation of facial features (mean 4.37 vs. 3.82, P < 0.001) and trust in creating a skincare management plan (mean 4.46 vs. 3.87, P < 0.001). Privacy and security concerns were prevalent, with 69% agreeing they were worried about security risks of AI facial imaging. Participants had confidence in AI technology for skincare evaluation and management, although they tended to prefer dermatologists over AI. Security was a concern for AI facial imaging.

abstract: RNAs are emerging as promising therapeutic targets, and small-molecule binding can modulate their structure and function, creating opportunities for therapeutic development. Accurate identification of RNA small-molecule binding sites is therefore important for understanding RNA-ligand interactions and facilitating RNA-targeted drug discovery. However, the structural complexity of RNA and the limited availability of experimentally characterized RNA-ligand complexes pose challenges for computational binding-site prediction. In this study, we propose RSMBind, a graph attention-based deep learning framework for nucleotide-level prediction of RNA-small molecule binding sites. The model integrates geometric descriptors of the local three-dimensional environment with pretrained RNA language model embeddings to capture complementary structural and sequence information. We investigate three pretrained RNA language models RNA-BERT, ERNIE-RNA and RNA-FM and assess the contributions of sequence representations and geometric features through feature-level ablation experiments. The model is developed using the TR60 and HARIBOSS datasets and evaluated on four independent benchmark datasets: RB9, TE18, TL12 and JL10. RSMBind achieves the highest MCC among the compared methods on three of the four benchmarks, with relative improvements of 17.1% on RB9, 7.2% on TL12 and 16.0% on JL10 over the best previously reported results, while achieving competitive performance on TE18. Furthermore, RSMBind retains predictive capability when using only pretrained RNA language model embeddings, highlighting their potential utility when explicit tertiary structural features are unavailable. Structural analysis indicates differences in prediction performance across RNA structural regions, with loop-associated binding sites generally being captured more effectively than those embedded within stem regions. Additionally, 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations of selected RNA-ligand complexes provide insights into the relationship between predicted binding probabilities and dynamic ligand proximity, further highlighting the role of conformational dynamics in evaluating structure-based predictions. The source code is available at [ https://github.com/sharma-nandita/RSMBind].
zh_abstract: RNA 正逐渐成为有前景的治疗靶点，小分子结合可以调节其结构和功能，为治疗开发创造机会。因此，准确识别 RNA 小分子结合位点对于理解 RNA-配体相互作用和促进 RNA 靶向药物发现很重要。然而，RNA 的结构复杂性以及实验表征的 RNA-配体复合物的有限可用性，给计算结合位点预测带来挑战。在本研究中，我们提出 RSMBind，一种基于图注意力的深度学习框架，用于在核苷酸水平预测 RNA-小分子结合位点。该模型将局部三维环境的几何描述符与预训练 RNA 语言模型嵌入相结合，以捕获互补的结构和序列信息。我们研究了三种预训练 RNA 语言模型 RNA-BERT、ERNIE-RNA 和 RNA-FM，并通过特征级消融实验评估序列表示和几何特征的贡献。该模型使用 TR60 和 HARIBOSS 数据集开发，并在四个独立基准数据集上评估：RB9、TE18、TL12 和 JL10。RSMBind 在四个基准中的三个上取得相比方法中最高的 MCC，相对于先前报告的最佳结果，在 RB9 上相对提升 17.1%，在 TL12 上提升 7.2%，在 JL10 上提升 16.0%，同时在 TE18 上取得有竞争力的性能。此外，RSMBind 在仅使用预训练 RNA 语言模型嵌入时仍保留预测能力，突显了在显式三级结构特征不可用时它们的潜在效用。结构分析表明不同 RNA 结构区域的预测性能存在差异，与环相关的结合位点通常比嵌入在茎区域的结合位点被更有效地捕获。此外，对选定 RNA-配体复合物进行的 100 ns 分子动力学模拟为预测结合概率与动态配体邻近性之间的关系提供了见解，进一步突出了构象动力学在评估基于结构的预测中的作用。源代码可在 [ https://github.com/sharma-nandita/RSMBind] 获取。

abstract: [Frontiers in psychology] This article presents a six-step ethical decision-making model for mental health professionals confronted with ethical concerns arising when clients use large language models (LLMs) for mental health support. LLMs may introduce ethical problems that existing decision-making models were not designed to address. To provide guidance, we synthesized two bodies of research, the first concerning ethical risks posed by LLM use, and the second about existing decision-making models, to create a new model designed specifically for LLM and AI-related ethical issues. Our model addresses AI-specific phenomena such as deceptive empathy, algorithmic bias, digital attachment, and diffuse accountability structures. We propose this model as a conceptual foundation and encourage its ongoing refinement as AI continues to evolve.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in psychology] 本文提出了一个六步伦理决策模型，供心理健康专业人员在来访者使用大语言模型（LLMs）寻求心理健康支持时处理由此产生的伦理担忧。LLMs 可能引入现有决策模型并非为应对而设计的伦理问题。为提供指导，我们综合了两类研究：第一类涉及使用 LLM 带来的伦理风险，第二类涉及现有决策模型，从而构建了一个专门针对 LLM 和 AI 相关伦理问题的新模型。我们的模型涉及 AI 特有现象，如欺骗性共情、算法偏见、数字依恋和分散的责任结构。我们提出该模型作为概念基础，并鼓励随着 AI 的持续演进对其进行不断完善。

title: HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
zh_title: HandsOnAid：离线急救助手小模型构建与评测
summary: 预印本用QLoRA微调4比特Gemma 2B构建离线急救助手，并以41题题库和多模型盲评打分。
key_points: 微调语料为5550对急救问答
评测用41对经医学审核的问答及12条安全覆盖
微调后均分较基线提升1.08至2.34
reason: 小模型应用预印本，评测集仅41题，属增量档偏上
abstract: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.
zh_abstract: 紧急情况可能发生在没有手机信号且附近没有救护车的地方。手机上的小型语言模型在此类情况下可能有帮助，但其建议必须安全且准确。我们构建了 HandsOnAid，这是一个 4-bit Gemma 2B 模型，在 FirstAidQA 数据集（包含 5,550 个急救问答对的语料库）上使用 QLoRA 微调。我们比较了七种配置，包括基础模型、4-bit 和 8-bit 微调模型，以及带长度下限、安全门控或检索的版本。我们使用了包含 41 个问答对的问答库，其医学审校参考文献遵循 ANZCOR 指南，并采用严格的 0-5 分评分细则，其中包含十二项安全覆盖。四个前沿 LLM 评审（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3）对每个答案进行盲评，并使用 45 个隐藏对照来检查评审可靠性。微调使平均分较基础模型提高 +1.08，达到 2.34。最佳配置得分为 2.51（满分 5 分），即带检索的微调 4-bit 模型。一名医学专业人员还对基础模型、4-bit 微调模型和检索配置的 40 个答案进行了盲评，其评分与 LLM 评审的平均分相似。关键词审计发现，训练语料库中对评分细则所要求的 ANZCOR 指南若干细节的覆盖有限，这表明训练数据中信息缺失可能是低分的原因。在智能手机设备（Pixel 7 Pro）上，使用六个 CPU 线程且无网络连接时，4-bit 微调模型在十个问题上平均在 6.86 秒内生成首个可显示文本，在 14.88 秒内生成完整答案。

title: A Stage-Wise Explainable Pipeline for Arteriolar-to-Venular Ratio Estimation and Retinopathy Screening
zh_title: 可解释的动静脉比值估计与视网膜病变筛查流程
summary: 提出五阶段可检查中间输出的眼底图像动静脉比值估计与筛查流程，仅在 30 张 HRF 图像上探索性评估。
key_points: 五阶段流程，各阶段中间输出可人工核查
显式阈值规则给出筛查决策，错误可溯源

abstract: The arteriolar-to-venular diameter ratio (AVR) is a clinically motivated marker of retinal vascular health. We present a five-stage pipeline for AVR estimation and exploratory retinopathy screening from fundus images, with inspectable intermediate outputs at each stage. The pipeline combines vessel and artery-vein masks, optic-disc localization, vessel-calibre estimation using a minimal-chord boundary walk, and AVR computation from dominant arterial and venular branches. An explicit threshold-based rule produces the screening decision, enabling errors to be traced to individual processing stages. On an exploratory cohort of 30 HRF images, we report 96.7% accuracy, an F1-score of 0.968 and ROC-AUC of 0.978. Ablation studies and an exploratory comparison with VascX examine the effects of vessel pairing, calibre measurement and aggregation. Interpretation is limited by the small cohort, proxy disease labels and absence of independent reference calibre measurements. The pipeline provides a transparent framework for investigating retinal vascular biomarkers, with further validation needed on larger, clinically graded cohorts.
zh_abstract: 小动脉-小静脉直径比（AVR）是一个具有临床意义的视网膜血管健康标志物。我们提出了一个用于从眼底图像估计 AVR 并进行探索性视网膜病变筛查的五阶段流程，每个阶段均有可检查的中间输出。该流程结合了血管掩膜与动脉-静脉掩膜、视盘定位、使用最小弦边界游走的血管管径估计，以及基于主要动脉和小静脉分支的 AVR 计算。一条明确的基于阈值的规则产生筛查决策，使错误能够追溯到各个处理阶段。在一个包含 30 幅 HRF 图像的探索性队列中，我们报告了 96.7% 的准确率、F1-score 为 0.968 以及 ROC-AUC 为 0.978。消融研究以及与 VascX 的探索性比较考察了血管配对、管径测量和聚合的影响。解释受到队列规模小、替代疾病标签以及缺乏独立参考管径测量的限制。该流程为研究视网膜血管生物标志物提供了一个透明框架，但仍需在更大、经临床分级的队列中进一步验证。
